title: Head of research infrastructure at a trading firm

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Thanks for meeting. How does your team use large models today?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Research uses them to summarize filings and earnings calls overnight. It all has to stay on our own hardware for compliance.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What's the main bottleneck in that workflow?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: The overnight batch barely finishes before the market opens. When it slips, analysts start the day without summaries.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Batch done by four a.m. with room to double the number of documents next year.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Have you looked at other ways to get there?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We tried CPU offload with open source tools. It worked, but throughput dropped by half.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Is there budget set aside for this?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: There's about two hundred thousand in this year's hardware budget, but it's use it or lose it by December.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Me for the pilot. Anything production goes to our COO and the compliance team.
